snippet.title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby – Girls' Legend U (Opening Movie)
snippet.description:
Their legend begins with you.

Guide your Umamusume to victory in Umamusume: Pretty Derby, now racing towards its English debut!


*The following lyrics are displayed incorrectly in the video. We apologize for the mistake.
Incorrect lyrics: On this beating of my heart, fluttering with joy
Correct lyrics: Oh this beating of my heart, fluttering with joy
